Get invoice location settings

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/invoice-location-settings

Retrieve invoice settings for a specific location. Creates default settings if none exist.

Permissions: 🔵 invoices.read

locationId
​number · required

Location ID to fetch settings for (required)

status

success

Update invoice location settings

PUT
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/invoice-location-settings

Days after due date to auto-mark as overdue

Run auto-send sweep

POST
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/invoices/auto-send/run

Tab UUID to pay

locationId
​number · required

Location ID

recipientId
​string · uuid

Invoice recipient UUID

referenceId
​string · uuid

Optional: recipient reference UUID — draft invoices accumulate per (recipient, reference).

selectedKitchenDispatchItemIds

Optional: specific kitchen dispatch item IDs to pay. If omitted, pays all unpaid items.
